spans.s: रक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Coloured, painted, tinged, आभाति बालातपरक्तसानुः सनिर्झरोद्गार इवाद्रिराजः R.vi.60; 2. red, crimson, रक्तांशुका नववधूरिव भाति भूमिः Rt.vi.20; 3. passionatet impassioned, attached, रक्तस्य रागपरिवृद्धिकरः प्रमोदः Mrich.iii.; 4. pleasant, sweet, charming, रक्तं च नाम मधुरं च समं स्फुटं च Mrich.iii., R.xvi.64; 5. fond of play, sportive, (pp. of रंज् q.v.).
रक्त (II) m. 1. Red colour; 2. safflower.
रक्त (III) n. 1. Blood; 2. copper; 3. saffron; 4. vermilion.

रक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Coloured, painted, tinged, आभाति बालातपरक्तसानुः सनिर्झरोद्गार इवाद्रिराजः R.vi.60; 2. red, crimson, रक्तांशुका नववधूरिव भाति भूमिः Rt.vi.20; 3. passionatet impassioned, attached, रक्तस्य रागपरिवृद्धिकरः प्रमोदः Mrich.iii.; 4. pleasant, sweet, charming, रक्तं च नाम मधुरं च समं स्फुटं च Mrich.iii., R.xvi.64; 5. fond of play, sportive, (pp. of रंज् q.v.).
रक्ता f. 1. Lac; 2. the gunjā plant.
रक्त-अक्ष (I) a. red-eyed.
रक्त-अक्ष (II) m. 1. a buffalo; 2. a pigeon.
रक्त-अंक m. coral.
रक्त-अंग m. 1. a bug; 2. the planet Mars.
रक्त-अंबर (I) n. a red garment.
रक्त-अंबर (II) m. a vagrant devotee wearing red garments.
रक्त-अर्बुद m. a bloody tumour.
रक्त-अशोक m. the red-flowered Aśoka.
रक्त-आधार m. the skin.
रक्त-आभ a. red-looking.
रक्त-आशय m. any viscus containing or secreting blood as the heart, the spleen or the liver.
रक्त-उत्पल n. 1. red chalk, red earth; 2. the red lotus.
रक्त-कंठ, -कंठिन् (I) a. sweet-voiced.
रक्त-कंठ, -कंठिन् (I) a. sweet-voiced.
रक्त-कंठिन् (II) m. the Indian cuckoo.
रक्त-कंद, -कंदल m. coral.
रक्त-कंद, -कंदल m. coral.
रक्त-चंदन n. 1. red sandal; 2. saffron.
रक्त-चूर्ण n. vermilion.
रक्त-च्छर्दि f. vomitting or spiting blood.
रक्त-जिह्व m. a lion.
रक्त-तुंड m. a parrot.
रक्त-धातु m. 1. red chalk or orpiment; 2. copper.
रक्त-पल्लव m. the Aśoka tree.
रक्त-पा f. a leach.
रक्त-पाद m. 1. a red-footed bird, a parrot; 2. a war-chariot.
रक्त-पायिन् m. a bug.
रक्त-पायिनी f. a leech.
रक्त-पिंड n. 1. a red boil; 2. a spontaneous discharge of blood from the nose and mouth.
रक्त-प्रमेह m. the passing of blood in the urine.
रक्त-मोक्ष m. bleeding.
रक्त-मोक्षण n. bleeding.
रक्त-वटी, -वरटी f. small-pox.
रक्त-वटी, -वरटी f. small-pox.
रक्त-वर्ग m. 1. lac; 2. the pomegranate tree; 3. safflower.
रक्त-वर्ण (I) m. 1. red colour; 2. cochineal insect.
रक्त-वर्ण (II) n. gold.
रक्त-शीर्षक m. a kind of heron.
रक्त-संध्यक n. the red lotus.
रक्तक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Red; 2. enamoured, fond of; 3. pleasing, amusing; 4. bloody.
रक्तक (II) m. 1. A red garment; 2. an impassioned man; 3. a sporter.
रक्तक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Red; 2. enamoured, fond of; 3. pleasing, amusing; 4. bloody.
रक्ति f. 1. Pleasingness, charmingness; 2. attachment, devotion, loyalty.
रक्तिका f. The seed of the gunjā plant used as a weight.
रक्तिमन् m. Redness.

रक्ष् vt. 1P (pp. रक्षित; pres. रक्षति) 1. To guard, to protect, असृष्ट यो यश्च भयेष्वरक्षीत् Bt.iii.4; 2. to preserve, to save, रक्षंतस्तपसि बलं च लोकपालाः Kir.v.50, R.ii.50; 3. to take care of, to watch, भवानिमां प्रतिकृतिं रक्षसु Sak.vi.(The root is often used with सम् without any change in meaning.)
रक्षक a. (f. क्षिका) A guardian, a protector, a guard.
रक्षक a. (f. क्षिका) A guardian, a protector, a guard.
रक्षण n. Watching, preserving, protecting.
रक्षण n. Watching, preserving, protecting.
रक्षणी f. Rein, bridle.
रक्षस् n. A demon, an imp, a goblin, रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवति सर्वे नमस्यंति च सिद्धसंघाः Bg.xi.36.
रक्षस्-सभ n. an assembly of demons.

रक्षा f. 1. The act of guarding, preservation, मयि सृष्टिर्हि लोकानां रक्षा युष्मास्ववस्थिता K.S.ii.28, R.ii.4; 2. a guard, a watch; 3. a tutelary deity; 4. ashes; 5. a preservative, an amulet used as a charm, (also रक्षिका in this sense), अहो रक्षाकरंडकमस्य मणिबंधे न दृश्यते Sak.vii.; 6. a piece of thread-silk bound round the wrist on the full-moon day of Śrāvaṇa and on some other occasions as a preservative; (also read रक्षी in this sense).
राक्षा f. incorrect form of लाक्षा q.v.
रक्षा-अधिकृत m. 1. a superintendent, a governor; 2. a magistrate, M.ix.172.
रक्षा-अपेक्षक m. 1. a door-keeper; 2. a guard of the women’s apartments; 3. a catamite; 4. an actor.
रक्षा-गृह n. a lying-in chamber, रक्षागृहगता दीपा प्रत्यादिष्टा इवाभवन् R.x.68.
रक्षा-पत्र m. a kind of birch tree.
रक्षा-पुरुष m. a watchman, a guard.
रक्षा-प्रदीप m. a light kept burning for protection against the evil spirits.
रक्षा-भूषण n. an ornament or jewel worn as a preservative.
रक्षा-मणि m. an ornament or jewel worn as a preservative.
रक्षिन् m. A guardian, guard, sentinel, अथवा ममापि नामशर्विलकस्य रक्षिणः Mrich.iii.
राका f. 1. The full-moon day or night, राकायामकलंकं चेदमृतांशोर्भवेद्वपुः K.Pr.x.; 2. a irl in whom menstruation has just commenced; 3. itch, scab.
राक्षस (I) a. (f. सी) Demoniacal, of the nature of a demon, Bg.ix.12.

राक्षस (II) m. 1. An evil spirit, a demon, an imp; 2. one of the eight forms of marriage; in it, the girl is forcibly carried away by capture, राक्षसो युद्धहरणात् Yaj.i.61; 3. name of the minister of Nandas, who figures as a prominent character in the Mudrārākshasa.
राक्षस (I) a. (f. सी) Demoniacal, of the nature of a demon, Bg.ix.12.
राक्षसी f. A female demon, R.xii.61.
